IT Specialist Job at Spring of Hope For the Girl Child Development Initiative




        
    

        
        Spring of Hope For the Girl Child Development Initiative (SHoGDI), commonly known as Spring of Hope Nigeria, is a human rights non-governmental organisation (NGO) based in Makurdi, Benue State, Nigeria. The organisation operates at the intersection of humanitarian response and community development, focusing primarily on empowering girls, young women, and other marginalized demographics.

We are recruiting to fill the position below:

 Job Position: IT Specialist

Job Location: Makurdi, Benue
Job type: Full-time

Job Description
     

            
    




	We are seeking an IT Specialist to manage our website and provide day-to-day technology support to our team.


Key Responsibilities


	Update and maintain the organisation's website, including project information, news and resources.
	Manage website security, backups, hosting and technical issues.
	Support staff with computers, email, internet connectivity and workplace software.
	Help maintain IT equipment, user accounts and digital tools used across projects.


Requirements


	At least two years of experience managing websites, preferably using WordPress or a similar platform.
	Practical experience troubleshooting computers, software and internet connectivity.
	Knowledge of website security, backups and hosting.
	Good communication skills and the ability to support colleagues with varying levels of technical experience.
	A qualification in IT, Computer Science or a related field is an advantage.


Method of Application 
Interested and qualified candidates should send their CV and a brief cover letter to: [email protected] CC: [email protected] using “IT Specialist Application” as the subject of the email.

Note: Qualified young women and persons with disabilities are strongly encouraged to apply.

Procurement Officer Job at Lekki Freeport Terminal




        
    

        
        Lekki Freeport Terminal (LFT) operates as the container terminal at Lekki Deep Sea Port, which is Nigeria's first true deep-sea port and one of the most advanced maritime gateways in West Africa. Strategically positioned within the Lagos Free Zone in Ibeju-Lekki, LFT is dedicated to connecting global trade to Nigeria in a sustainable manner, utilising robust automation, digitisation, and innovation from the moment vessels board to the delivery of cargo while adhering to international safety standards.
     

            
    



The terminal takes advantage of deep water, with a draft of up to 16.5 m, and modern ship-to-shore capabilities, enabling it to accommodate large vessels and handle significant cargo volumes. This is part of a port complex designed to scale for millions of TEUs annually. The depth and infrastructure of the terminal contribute to reducing logistics costs and alleviating congestion along the Lagos corridor, establishing LFT as a key driver of regional trade growth.

We are recruiting to fill the position below:

 Job Position: Procurement Officer

Job Location: Ibeju Lekki, Lagos
Employment Type: Full-time

Position Summary


	With the supervision of the procurement supervisor, this position is expected to support the delivery of processes and procedures set in the procurement team to achieve results in a timely manner, as non-delivery has a direct impact on the terminal's ability to function.


Key Responsibilities


	Under the supervision of the procurement supervisor, monitors the level of inventory, supplies of equipment and equipment parts for the company.
	Files purchase requisitions.
	Keeps record of tender of bids and ensure appropriate fillings.
	Follows procedures for procurement policy made by the CFO.
	Complies lists used in selecting vendors based on capabilities, performance, and consistent quality assurance.
	Maintains rapport and good working relationships with vendors; keeps accurate vendor records.
	Follows the process set for purchase orders as necessary and ensures delivery of purchased items uninterrupted.
	Performs other purchasing or inventory control duties as necessary or as requested.
	Ensures that he/she follows the proper inventory control system put in place and carefully monitors stock positions, reports levels and obsolescence of stock.
	Carry out regular stock reviews with the store team and check?ups to confirm actual quantities, spot shortages early, and ensure materials are available when needed.
	Monitor and manage auto?PRs generated from inventory levels, making sure they are accurate, timely, and align with technical and operational requirements.


Critical Qualifications


	Requires a College Degree in Business Management, or a related discipline. Some formal instruction in engineering or an engineering-related experience is helpful.
	Requires at least one year of purchasing experience in the private industry, preferably in shipping or transportation industry.
	Have knowledge of procurement practices and principles.
	Understanding ofERPand some complexity between Inventory, Procurement and Finance systems.
	Demonstrated negotiation skills.
	Exercise sound business judgment to set direction and establish priorities.
	Requires verbal and written communications skills in English at the advanced level.
	Requires analytical skills, including the ability to extract, compile and analyze data.
	Must be able to understand basic finance and accounting principles to control budgets & costs.
	Knowledge of contract laws and conditions.
	Very high ethical standards.


Learning & Career Opportunities:
In this position, the incumbent will have an opportunity to acquire skills and knowledge in the following areas:


	Exposure to inventory management, technical procurement, and terminal operations in the maritime sector.
	Exposure to related terminal operations training and knowledge-sharing sessions.

Project Electrical Engineer Job at Amaiden Energy Nigeria Limited




        
    

        
        Amaiden Energy Nigeria Limited (formerly Moody International Nigeria Limited) was established in 1996 as a partnership between Moody International Group and Nigerian investors. Since commencing operations in March 1997 the company continues to grow and exerts its presence in numerous Projects in the Nigeria Oil and Gas Industry.

We are recruiting to fill the position below:

 Job Position: Project Electrical Engineer

Job Location: Port Harcourt, Rivers

Main Functions
     

            
    




	We are seeking an experienced project electrical engineer to serve as the Company's resident electrical engineering authority across its facilities in Nigeria.
	The successful candidate will be responsible for the complete electrical engineering lifecycle of capital projects and facilities management works, including design, technical review, construction supervision, quality control, contractor management, testing, compliance, and as-built documentation.
	The role requires a highly experienced professional who can manage multiple projects and sites, work effectively with contractors and consultants, and ensure all electrical works comply with Company specifications, regulatory requirements, and international engineering standards.


Tasks and Responsibilities


	Develop conceptual and detailed electrical designs, drawings, specifications, and technical documentation.
	Review and validate electrical designs, shop drawings, and technical submissions from consultants and contractors.
	Supervise electrical construction activities across Company locations and ensure compliance with approved drawings and specifications.
	Conduct site inspections, quality assurance/quality control checks, and identify and resolve defects and non-conformances.
	Supervise testing and approval of electrical materials, equipment, and installations.
	Prepare site inspection reports, punch lists, progress reports, and other technical documentation.
	Provide technical guidance on electrical construction methods, sequencing, installation, and best practices.
	Coordinate electrical works with architectural, structural, mechanical, and other engineering disciplines.
	Monitor contractor and consultant performance and ensure compliance with project requirements.
	Review completed works against approved-for-construction drawings before sign-off.
	Ensure electrical drawings and documentation are updated throughout the project lifecycle.
	Ensure accurate preparation and maintenance of as-built drawings and technical records.
	Support the development and improvement of company electrical standards, procedures, and engineering practices.
	Ensure all activities are carried out in accordance with applicable HSE requirements and company procedures.
	Travel regularly to company locations as required by project and operational needs.


Job Requirements


	Bachelor's Degree (B.Sc./B.Eng.) in Electrical Engineering or an equivalent qualification from a recognized institution.
	Minimum of 15 years of post-qualification experience in electrical engineering, construction, engineering consultancy, project engineering, or a related environment.
	COREN registration is mandatory.
	Proven experience delivering electrical engineering works throughout the project lifecycle, from design through construction and handover.
	Demonstrated experience in construction supervision and contractor/consultant management.
	Experience in oil & gas, energy, industrial, or large multi-site corporate environments is highly desirable.
	Strong knowledge of electrical design, construction standards, quality control, and applicable Nigerian and international standards.
	Advanced proficiency in AutoCAD.
	Knowledge of BIM and other engineering/design software is an advantage.
	Experience preparing and reviewing technical specifications, Bills of Quantities (BOQs), drawings, and project documentation.
	Strong understanding of the interface between electrical, mechanical, structural, and architectural works.
	Excellent technical reporting, communication, coordination, and problem-solving skills.
